annotation.title_clean: 89/415/EEC: Council Decision of 20 June 1989 instituting a specific programme for the research and development of statistical expert systems (Doses)
annotation.title_en: 89/415/EEC: Council Decision of 20 June 1989 instituting a specific programme for the research and development of statistical expert systems (Doses)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 200
annotation.summary_en: 1989 Council Decision establishing the four-year Doses research programme on statistical expert systems, with a budget of ECU 4 million. It sets programme structure, shared-cost contracts, Commission implementation with an advisory committee, evaluation reporting, and third-country cooperation. No robotics or embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adopts the Doses programme for four years from 27 June 1989
Commission implements, assisted by an advisory committee of Member State representatives
Commission must review the programme in year two and evaluate it at the end
Authorises agreements with third countries and organisations such as OECD and COST
